title: Max-envelope test hardening (DB-046 a-f): fail-closed consistency raise + live 500 + out-of-bounds + multi-floor proof + conflict-advisory + drift-guard - TEST-ONLY, zero production-code change
objective: Close the six reviewer-specified coverage gaps on the accepted M5-T064 max-envelope surface with TESTS ONLY (both source files are byte-frozen accepted material - any production-code edit fails this packet): (a) drive a >100ft multi-floor binding height through the FULL generator-checker consistency proof; (b) exercise _conflict_advisory's populated branch with a conflict-producing registry double; (c) add a one-line drift-guard pinning the engine's _LOT_AREA_INPUT to the checker's constant (mirroring the _USABLE_COVERAGE guard); (d) prove the generator-checker FAIL-CLOSED raise - monkeypatch check_proposal to FAIL a saturating dimension and assert MaxEnvelopeError(field='candidate.*'), plus a route test asserting that maps to the bounded generic 500; (e) exercise the (500, internal_error) matrix row LIVE (force one 500, assert the fixed generic body, no exception detail, X-Correlation-ID present); (f) an out-of-EPSG:2263-NYC-bounds lot asserting the typed LOT_GEOMETRY_UNSUPPORTED gap. Every new test mutation-sensitive; the existing 56 stay green unchanged.
business_reason: The G4 review proved the affirmative behaviors but showed a mutant silencing the fail-closed raise or leaking detail on the 500 path would survive CI - closing that before the mount seam keeps the envelope's defining failure mode provably fail-closed
inputs: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE (binding): in every checkpoint, OMIT the four envelope fields entirely - the controller fills them. If you supply one it must be EXACT full-length (40-hex SHA, FULL worktree path).

REPORT DISCIPLINE (binding): reference files and line anchors, never embed long verbatim sections; every checkpoint carries IMPLEMENTATION; one concise evidence pass with explicit cwd; the supervisor re-collects evidence at harvest.
COMMAND CWD (binding): api work runs from services/api - `python -m ruff check .` FIRST, then the documented pytest; `python tools/modularity_check.py --check` from repo root.

TEST-ONLY WALL (binding): the engine (max_envelope.py) and route (max_envelope_api.py) are byte-frozen ACCEPTED material and are FORBIDDEN - every gap closes with test code alone (monkeypatch/fixture doubles). If you believe a gap CANNOT close without a production edit, STOP and report exactly why in your checkpoint - never edit the frozen files.

SPEC SOURCE (binding): the six gaps are specified verbatim in project-control/reports/M5-T064-G3.md (advisories 1-3) and M5-T064-G4.md (gaps 1-3) with exact line anchors - implement exactly those recommendations: (a) multi-floor >100ft height through the FULL consistency proof; (b) conflict-producing registry double for _conflict_advisory's populated branch; (c) _LOT_AREA_INPUT drift-guard mirroring test_usable_coverage_matches_accepted_checker; (d) monkeypatch check_proposal->FAIL asserting MaxEnvelopeError(field='candidate.*') + the route 500 mapping; (e) one LIVE 500 asserting the fixed generic body, no exception detail, X-Correlation-ID; (f) out-of-EPSG:2263-NYC-bounds lot asserting the typed LOT_GEOMETRY_UNSUPPORTED gap.

CODE-GRAPH NAVIGATION BLOCK (D-066-R001; graph regenerated this session at the T067 seam: 793 files/16728 nodes/7304 edges; the two test files' only production imports are the frozen engine/route + accepted proposal_checks/scenario modules - all read-only): no consumer outside the two test files depends on them; no sweep duty beyond keeping the existing 56 tests green unchanged.
outputs: Six new mutation-sensitive tests (or minimally more) closing DB-046 (a)-(f); the existing 56 stay green unchanged; zero production-code change
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (fail-closed proof, DB-046 d): with check_proposal monkeypatched to FAIL a saturating dimension, derive_max_envelope raises MaxEnvelopeError with field='candidate.<dim>'; reverting the engine's raise (simulated by asserting the mutant behavior) would turn the test red; a route test proves that error maps to the bounded generic 500.

AS-2 (live 500, DB-046 e): at least one route test produces a REAL 500 (e.g. registry resolution forced to raise) and asserts the fixed generic body, absence of exception detail, and the X-Correlation-ID header.
AS-3 (out-of-bounds, DB-046 f): a lot anchored outside the EPSG:2263 NYC bounds yields the typed LOT_GEOMETRY_UNSUPPORTED gap, never a candidate.
AS-4 (multi-floor proof, DB-046 a): a binding height >100ft flows through the FULL generator-checker consistency proof (checker re-run PASSes the multi-floor candidate).

AS-5 (conflict advisory + drift guard, DB-046 b/c): the populated _conflict_advisory branch is exercised via a conflict-producing registry double (advisory surfaced, never resolved); a drift-guard pins _LOT_AREA_INPUT to the checker's constant.
AS-6 (preservation): the pre-existing 56 tests pass unchanged; ruff clean; modularity exit 0; the frozen engine/route files are byte-identical before and after.
risks: Monkeypatching the checker must target the ENGINE's imported reference (max_envelope.check_proposal), not the source module, or the patch silently misses - a vacuous-pass hazard the report must prove against (assert the raise actually fired).
Forcing a live 500 must not weaken the leak assertions - the test asserts what the body does NOT contain (exception text) as well as what it does.
The test-only wall is absolute: any production-file edit fails the packet.
